name: Large Personalized Bowl
snippet: For the big dogs who deserve big things.
story: The big dogs have waited long enough. I make these larger bowls for the golden retrievers, the labs, and the Great Danes of the world — wide and sturdy enough that they can eat without knocking it across the kitchen. Tell me the name and colors and I'll make it right.
details: 📏 Size: Large — suited for medium to large breeds
🎨 Customization: Pet's name + glaze color choice
🍽️ Safety: Food safe, dishwasher safe, kiln-fired
